name: Twenty
verdict: No OAuth app is known, so each customer's workspace admin likely creates an API key and pastes it in with their base URL (cloud or self-hosted). Low confidence and unverified; likely 1-3 days, no review.
needGuide: No — just collect each customer's API key and base URL (Settings → APIs & Webhooks), after confirming Twenty still has no OAuth.

auth.detail: Likely: per-workspace API keys used as Bearer tokens against REST and GraphQL; cloud uses Twenty's hosted API, self-hosted uses the instance's own domain. Twenty also has an Apps framework (TypeScript packages) per its docs index; whether it exposes third-party OAuth was not verified.

approval.gate: None for API keys: each customer generates a key in their own workspace and pastes it into your app along with the base URL (cloud vs self-hosted). Likely no marketplace review, but unverified.

scopes.why: Likely no scope model: permissions follow the role assigned to the API key (unverified).
scopes.summary: Likely no per-scope model: permissions follow the role assigned to the API key; metadata API access may require an elevated role. Unverified.

cost: Free to self-host or try cloud; key creation likely free

testing: Self-host with Docker or use a Twenty cloud trial workspace as the test tenant; both are free to start.
